description: This file defines the FundTransferService class, which handles fund transfer operations within the internet banking application. It manages the transfer process, interacts with the database repository for saving transfer records, and communicates with an external banking core service via a Feign client.

classes.name: FundTransferService
classes.description: A service class that manages fund transfer processes, including saving transfer details, calling external banking APIs, and updating transfer statuses.

methods.name: fundTransfer
methods.description: Handles a fund transfer request by saving initial transaction data, calling an external service for processing, and updating the transaction status upon success.

methods.name: readAllTransfers
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all fund transfers, converting entity models to DTOs.
